resources.string: Let the agent use this phone: read how it is, or do something on it. Every tool is off until you turn it on, and anything that changes the phone asks you first: in Kyllene while it’s open, else in a notification. A tool you turn off is taken away from the agent at once.
It offers the agent the tools you turn on here, and passes their calls to this phone.
Let the agent use this phone
Off. The agent can’t use this phone.
On. Turn on below each tool the agent may use.

resources.string: Waiting to connect to the gateway.
Needs the herald-push plugin on the gateway.
The gateway’s herald-push plugin is %1$s; phone tools need %2$s. Update it below.
The gateway’s herald-push plugin is too old.
Every approval or question from a chat you’re not looking at rings like a call. Decline it for the usual notification. It only ever rings you: the agent never calls anyone from this phone.
Answering puts Hermes on the line: it asks in its own words, you answer by voice, and you can talk on. Off, Answer opens the chat instead.

Kyllene on your watch rings as well. On a Wear OS watch, Answer starts a call from the watch, when your gateway talks live. On a Pebble, Answer shows the question there when Answer on the Pebble is on; else answer on your phone.
They start and end at %1$s, so nothing is quiet yet: pick another time.
Nothing rings between the times you pick.

%1$s The agent is told to reach you another way; approvals and questions come as notifications. Do Not Disturb silences them too, unless you let Kyllene interrupt it. A second call from one chat within 15 minutes gets through, like a repeat caller.

A chat you send from a phone uses that phone. Scheduled jobs and chats from Hermes Desktop or the dashboard use the first phone in this list with the tool on. A phone you remove comes back if Kyllene on it is still signed in with phone tools on.
The agent stops using its phone tools, and calls waiting for it are refused. If Kyllene on that phone is still signed in with phone tools on, it comes back the next time it connects.
Android checks every few minutes, so a message can come a little late. It’s sent as you, marked as coming from the place.
Watched places is off, so none of these fire.
Turn on Kyllene’s notifications: changes are asked there.
Allow Kyllene to change Do Not Disturb.
Give Kyllene Usage access, to see which apps you use.
Allow Kyllene to use this phone’s location.
Allow precise location: Android only watches places with it.
Allow location all the time: places are watched while Kyllene is closed. Choose “Allow all the time”.
Allow Kyllene to use your calendar.
Allow Kyllene to read your contacts.
Update Health Connect, where the data comes from.
Install Health Connect, where the data comes from.
This phone has no Health Connect.
Allow Kyllene to read steps, sleep or heart rate in Health Connect.
Turn on Kyllene’s notifications: the call rings there.
Allow full-screen notifications, so the call shows over the lock screen.
Phone tools work from Kyllene on an Android phone.
Also steps, sleep or heart rate (optional)
The level, whether it’s charging, and the time until full.
Wi-Fi, mobile data or offline, whether it’s metered, and a VPN.
Do Not Disturb, the ringer and volumes. A change asks you first.
Sets one in your clock app after you allow it.
Which apps you used and for how long, screen-on time and unlocks, up to a week back.
Opens a link, a place, an app or the share sheet after you allow it.
Puts text on your clipboard after you allow it. Never reads what’s there.
Where the phone is and the nearest address, as precisely as you allow. While Kyllene is open, unless you also allow it while closed.
Arriving at or leaving a place sends its message to the chat it was added from. Adding or removing one asks you first; needs precise location all the time.
Your events in a time range. Adding or moving one asks you first.
Looks people up by name, number or email: only their names, numbers and emails, a few at a time.
Steps, sleep and heart rate from Health Connect, as much of it as you allow there. While Kyllene is open, unless you also allow it while closed.
The agent draws a small screen under its reply, with buttons, choices or a form, and waits up to 5 minutes for your tap. Android only.
The agent rings you when something can’t wait, or when you ask it to call you, from a scheduled job too. Answer, and Hermes tells you why on the line. It only ever calls you.
